newsitem.title: USA: Blue Square-Israel says to get IKEA license.
newsitem.headline: Blue Square-Israel says to get IKEA license.

text.p: Blue Square-Israel Ltd said Wednesday that Inter Ikea Systems BV plans to grant a license to a consortium comprised of Blue Square and Fishman Holdings Ltd license to open IKEA stores in Israel.
The parties intend to finalize the terms of the license within the next thirty days, Blue Square said in a press release.
Blue Square says it is the largest retailer in the state of Israel both in terms of sales volume and number of stores.
Through its supermarkets and department and specialty stores, the company offers a wide range of consumer products, including food and beverages, apparel, housewares, electronics, and cosmetics.
